text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Scarborough Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The report responds to an application submitted by the property owner of 31 McDonald Avenue requesting approval for a site-specific Fence Exemption under Section 447-1.2B(1) of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 – Fences. The property owner is seeking Council’s permission to maintain a vertical wooden fence in the rear yard, where the south side fence measures approximately 2.16 metres (7 feet 1 inch) in height, and the north side fence measures approximately 2.24 metres (7 feet 4 inches) in height. Both sides of the rear yard fence measure approximately 21.5 metres (70 feet) in length. This fence does not comply with the height requirements set out in Chapter 447 of the Toronto Municipal Code, which limits the maximum height of a rear yard…

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Granted a fence exemption permit to the property owner of 31 McDonald Avenue and that at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the installation comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
